description: Pipeline check of the linear ring, run end to end by tests/test_linear_ring_smoke.py; it does not test the theory's data term. N = 16, hidden length_scale 2, P = 32, m = n = 4, K = 2, beta 0.25, B = 256, 10^4 epochs, records every 250 epochs, CPU. linear_teacher with an orthonormal teacher and latents uniform on [0, 1]; L = 1, phi id, g 1; k0 = k1 = 1 (input and output kernels of length_scale 0 and amplitude 1, weight_lambda 1); r = rate_lambda = 0; SGLD, float64; every population on the deterministic grid with box = N, so length scales are in sites; init prior. One sample per member, its final state; statistics are read off the member-averaged final-state spectrum with bootstrap errors over members, after removing the frequencies the penalty floor raises (min_rel_eig of the top hidden eigenvalue) from both paths' spectra; the records feed only the relaxation diagnostic. At beta 0.25 the prediction is within 0.15 SE of the prior alone, and the theory's finite-N error (about 0.5-0.6 SE at B = 256) exceeds the data term. Both settings start from the prior, so a sampler that never moved would pass the comparison; the test also requires each member's final tuning maps to have decorrelated from its initial ones. min_rel_eig 1e-3 floors |q| >= 5 (lambda_q / lambda_0 <= 4.5e-4; 2e-3 of the penalty path's predicted power), excluded from both paths' statistics; the floor keeps the penalty's softest data-carrying mode relaxing in about 2000 epochs. The axes cross spatial.parametrisation [penalty, whitened] with train.lr [6e-4, 0.005], and the diagonal is the test: settings 0 and 3 (`exp run ROOT --index 0` and `--index 3`); setting 1 (penalty at 0.005) is refused at run start by the penalty's step check, setting 2 runs. The pipeline's thresholds are fct.linear_ring.pipeline_bounds (PIPELINE_N_SE x PIPELINE_SE_MARGIN delta-method SEs), deliberately not the experiments' rule (disagrees, with its follow-up), so that the test needs no follow-up run. The lrs keep both checks far inside their bounds so the Euler bias stays below the test's resolution: the penalty check value lr weight_lambda stiffness / (2 beta) is 0.24 (floored modes inflated 1.3x), the whitened lr lambda_max(loss Hessian) 0.031 (lambda_max 6.1; prior modes inflated 1%); 0.9 of each bound would inflate every prior mode of the whitened net 1.4x here.
